steps.name: Install reviewed exact CI driver versions
steps.run: node --input-type=module -e 'import {execFileSync} from "node:child_process"; import {mkdirSync,writeFileSync,readFileSync} from "node:fs"; import {selectVersions} from "./bench/p0/versions.mjs"; import {writeArtifacts,summarize} from "./bench/p0/index.mjs"; const out="proof/runs/p0"; mkdirSync(out,{recursive:true}); try { const catalog=JSON.parse(readFileSync("bench/drivers.json","utf8")); const versions=selectVersions(catalog,JSON.parse(process.env.AUN_P0_VERSIONS||"{}")); writeFileSync(out+"/install-versions.json",JSON.stringify(versions,null,2)+"\n"); execFileSync("npm",["install","--save-dev","--package-lock=false","--no-audit","--no-fund",...Object.entries(versions).map(([name,version])=>name+"@"+version)],{stdio:"inherit"}); } catch(error) { await writeArtifacts(out,[{suite:"SETUP",status:"failed",error:{name:error.name,message:error.message,stack:error.stack}}],{schemaVersion:1,commit:process.env.GITHUB_SHA},summarize([],40)); throw error; }'
